render.headline: $100 sale.
render.subheadline: Same Square checkout. Very different processing cost.

posts.text:
$100 sale. Same Square checkout. Very different processing cost.

On Square Free, a $100 in-person card payment costs $2.75 to process (2.6% + 15¢). Square says Bitcoin payments are 0% processing through Dec. 31, 2026, then 1%.

The useful merchant question isn’t ‘do I believe in Bitcoin?’ It’s: if customers already want to pay this way, why not measure the economics?

Eligible U.S. sellers only; availability can vary; not available to New York sellers; Square currently caps Bitcoin payments at $600.
